title: Finite affine module charts for eventual flatness descent
statement: Let $I$ be a directed partially ordered set, $R:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ a ring diagram, $c$ a limiting cone of $\operatorname{Spec}(R_k)$ with affine point, $i\in I$, and $f:X_i\to\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)$ a finitely presented morphism [def-pc-scheme] [def-pc-morphism-conventions]. Let $M$ be a finitely presented quasi-coherent module on $X_i$. Suppose its pullback to $X_i\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)}c.\mathrm{pt}$ is flat over $c.\mathrm{pt}$ [def-pc-base-change] [def-pc-scheme-module-flat-over]. Put $C=\operatorname{colim}R$, with the specified coprojection $R_i\to C$. There exist $n\in\mathbb N$, commutative rings $B_b$, $B_b$-modules $N_b$, and ring maps $a_b:R_i\to B_b$, for $b\in\operatorname{Fin}(n)$, such that $B_b$ is finitely presented over $R_i$ and $N_b$ is finitely presented over $B_b$ [def-sc-finitely-presented-module]. For a coprojection or transition $R_i\to T$, put $D_T=T\otimes_{R_i}R_i$ with its right $R_i$-algebra structure, and restrict $N_b$ along $a_b$. Each $D_C\otimes_{R_i}N_b$ is flat over $D_C$. For every $k\ge i$, if every $D_{R_k}\otimes_{R_i}N_b$ is flat over $D_{R_k}$, then the pullback of $M$ to $X_i\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)}\operatorname{Spec}(R_k)$ is flat over $\operatorname{Spec}(R_k)$. This is finite affine comparison and gluing, with no assertion of eventual flatness.

proof.text: Quasi-compactness of f over the affine base gives CompactSpace X_i. Choose one affine neighbourhood per point and extract a finite subcover indexed by Fin(n), realizing [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-finite-affine-open-cover]. Construct B_b and N_b as actual sections and a_b as GammaSpecIso.inv followed by f.appLE. Use [lem-weil-pbc-lfp-affine-opens-finite-presentation] and composition with the bijective spectrum-sections map for algebra finite presentation. Use [lem-weil-pbc-finite-presentation-affine-sections] for module finite presentation. No algebra or module data is chosen from an unproved theorem.

Spec preserves limits as a right adjoint. Apply isLimitOfPreserves Scheme.Spec to the opposite of colimit.isColimit R. Uniqueness against hc gives e: c.pt = Spec(colimit R), and conePointUniqueUpToIso_hom_comp gives e.hom followed by Spec of the coprojection equal to the prescribed cone projection. This direct three-line categorical proof avoids the general affine-transition limit theorem.

Apply the forward direction of [lem-pc-affine-cover-module-tensor-flat-criterion] to the constructed cover, the colimit coprojection, e and its projection equation. The supplied hflat gives every required limit tensor flatness assertion.

At each k >= i apply the reverse direction of [lem-pc-affine-cover-module-tensor-flat-criterion] with q = R.map(homOfLE hik), p = Spec.map q and e the identity of Spec(R_k). The tensor hypotheses give precisely the stage IsFlatOver conclusion. No eventual descent is used.

proof_origin.place: Finite affine reduction, specialized to target equal to base; explicit chart construction and categorical Spec-colimit comparison, using the fixed-cover criterion.
